docs.title: About this book
docs.text:
Why poverty deepens as wealth grows, and George's remedy: a single tax on the value of land.

From Standard Ebooks · CC0 1.0

Henry George (1839–1897), Progress and Poverty, 1879. This book is not stored in this library: each chapter is read from the public repository of its Standard Ebooks edition when it is opened, shown in this library's format, and ends with its own attribution. Standard Ebooks edition, CC0 1.0 (public domain dedication); transcription originally from Project Gutenberg. Modified: converted to this format.
